name: Soldier
title: SOLDIER — Forged in Battle
cardBlurb: How did you spend the years leading up to a life of adventure?
flavour: War has been your life for as long as you care to remember. You trained as a youth, studied the use of weapons and armour, and learned basic survival techniques.
toolNote: You can expertly drive carts and wagons. Useful on the road to Phandalin.

traits: I'm always polite and respectful — until someone draws steel.
I can stare down a hell hound without flinching.
I face problems head-on. A simple, direct solution is the best path.
I never leave a companion behind, no matter the cost.
I keep my kit immaculate. A soldier's gear is their lifeline.
I speak little, but I remember every face I've fought beside.
ideals: Duty. My word, once given, is iron.
Courage. Fear is a compass — it points at what matters.
Comrades. No one fights alone while I draw breath.
Honour. A clean fight and a clean conscience.
Freedom. No tyrant's banner flies over my road.
Glory. Let the bards earn their keep.
bonds: I carry a token from a fallen shield-sibling.
The folk of Phandalin are under my protection now.
I owe Gundren Rockseeker a debt I mean to repay.
My old unit's banner is folded in my pack.
Someone back in Neverwinter is counting on my pay.
The road itself is my home; I defend all who walk it.
flaws: I charge in before the plan is finished.
I trust soldiers and distrust smooth talkers.
Old war wounds ache when rain is coming — and I complain.
I can't resist a wager or a contest of strength.
I drink to forget the worst days, then remember them anyway.
I follow orders even when my gut says otherwise.
